_keys_note: OQ-GFX-PRESETS (placeholders): art_glow_enabled = bloom (a full-screen blur chain: the most expensive switch here on the Mobile renderer); art_grade_enabled = brightness / contrast / saturation in the tonemap pass; art_weather_enabled = dust motes or rain particles around the camera; art_shafts_enabled = additive sun shaft quads; art_vignette_enabled = one blended full-screen rectangle; art_backdrop_enabled = the outer wall ring, towers, spires, far aqueduct, hills and ground skirt beyond the playable square (five batches and two meshes, no shadows); art_debanding_enabled = dithering of smooth gradients in the tonemap pass (the match's viewport); fx_ssr_enabled, fx_ssao_enabled, fx_ssil_enabled and fx_volumetric_fog_enabled = effects only the Forward+ renderer draws (off for the Mobile renderer; OQ-GFX-RENDERER). Each may be turned off without touching code.
